page_title: WOL 1-4 BHA | Wolves v Brighton 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Andy Madley has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Adam Webster (Brighton) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90+5' Matheus Nunes (Wolves) is given a yellow card by Andy Madley and because it's his second one today, the game is over for him.
90+3' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) will deliver the corner kick.
88' Max Kilman (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hugo Bueno (Wolves) comes onto the pitch so that Rayan Ait Nouri can be given a rest.
86' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
83' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
81' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Kaoru Mitoma is replaced by Adam Lallana (Brighton).
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pascal Gross will be replaced by Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton).
76' Matheus Nunes (Wolves) is booked.
76' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
75' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner kick, but Jason Steele reads it well and stops the effort.
74' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
73' Flag goes up against Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
71' Here is a change. Craig Dawson is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Toti (Wolves).
69' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
67' That will be all from Julio Enciso who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
64' Joao Pedro (Brighton) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
63' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
62' Referee Andy Madley points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Wolves players celebrate.
62' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Wolves can stand using VAR.
61' 1 - 4 Pablo Sarabia takes the corner and Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) rises highest in the middle of the box to plant a precise header into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:4.
60' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
60' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' Julio Enciso (Brighton) forces a pass into the box, but Jose Sa is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
57' The game has come to an end for James Milner. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joel Veltman (Brighton).
57' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Joao Pedro (Brighton) replaces Danny Welbeck.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Gomes trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Fabio Silva.

55' 0 - 4 A superb goal from great team play! Solly March (Brighton) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
51' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Julio Enciso tees up Solly March (Brighton) inside the box and he slams the ball into the roof of the net and past Jose Sa.
46' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Kaoru Mitoma laid the ball off to Pervis Estupinan (Brighton), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
40' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
37' Pedro Neto (Wolves) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
34' A corner kick by Brighton is thwarted by the well prepared Jose Sa (Wolves).
34' Julio Enciso (Brighton) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
33' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Joao Gomes (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
29' Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.

29' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Fabio Silva (Wolves) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Jason Steele pulls off a brilliant save. Wolves get a corner.
26' Craig Dawson (Wolves) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
24' Mario Lemina (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andy Madley signals.
23' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Matheus Nunes (Wolves) heads on.
22' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Billy Gilmour (Brighton).
19' Julio Enciso (Brighton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
18' The referee is firm and issues James Milner (Brighton) a deserved yellow card.
17' This is a yellow card! Craig Dawson (Wolves) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

15' 0 - 1 Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Jose Sa is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
14' Julio Enciso (Brighton) forces a pass into the box, but Jose Sa is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
10' Solly March (Brighton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
8' Pascal Gross (Brighton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
7' The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
7' The ball is cleared after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
5' A player from Brighton commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
3' A goal, which was scored by Fabio Silva (Wolves), was disallowed due to offside.
2' Solly March (Brighton) is about to take a corner kick.
1' Pedro Neto (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
